text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of girls enrolled in upper secondary school
Comparing net and gross enrollment ratios for girls in upper secondary education. Net enrollment shows the
share of girls of upper secondary school age (typically 15–17 years) who are enrolled, while gross enrollment
includes all girls regardless of age, expressed as a percentage of girls of the same age group.
